posts.title: The gauntlet loop — stop letting your AI grade its own homework
posts.description: A post-deliverable QA ritual: fan out independent critics, compare against real examples, and recurse until zero open critiques.
keyTakeaways: Self-review fails — an agent grading its own output rubber-stamps and misses real gaps
Fan out independent critics (Inspector, Comparator, Evaluator); nobody reviews their own work
Critiques need severity tiers (P0–P3) and a real-world reference, not vague feedback
Done means zero open P0/P1 and an at-or-above-bar comparison against a real shipped example

posts.title: Building AI agents that ship — lessons from the field
posts.description: Lessons learned building and deploying AI systems across four companies — from guardrails and monitoring to shipping fast.
keyTakeaways: The agent is 20% of the work — guardrails, monitoring, fallbacks are the other 80%
Every successful AI feature started with a written plan
Ship behind a feature flag, watch metrics, iterate fast
Open source is the best forcing function for quality
